text_en: Brothers and sisters, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for them is that they may be saved.
text_cn: 弟兄们！我心里所怀的切望，向天主所恳求的，就是为使我的同胞获得救恩。

text_en: I can testify that they have a zeal for God, but it is not enlightened.
text_cn: 我可以为他们作证：他们对天主有热心，但不合乎真知超见，

text_en: For, being ignorant of the righteousness that comes from God, and seeking to establish their own, they have not submitted to God’s righteousness.
text_cn: 因为他们不认识由天主而来的正义，企图建立自己的正义，而不顺从天主的正义：

text_en: For Christ is the end of the law so that there may be righteousness for everyone who believes.
text_cn: 因为法律的终向是基督，使凡信他的人获得正义。

text_en: Moses writes concerning the righteousness that comes from the law, that “the person who does these things will live by them. ”
text_cn: 关于出自法律的正义，梅瑟曾写过：“遵守法律的人，必因法律而生活。”

text_en: But the righteousness that comes from faith says, “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven? ’” (that is, to bring Christ down)
text_cn: 但是，出自信仰的正义却这样说：“你心里不要说：谁能升到天上去？”意思是说：使基督从那里下来；

text_en: “or ‘Who will descend into the abyss? ’” (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).
text_cn: 也不要说：“谁能下到深渊里去？”意思是说：把基督从死者中领上来。

text_en: But what does it say? “The word is near you, on your lips and in your heart” (that is, the word of faith that we proclaim);
text_cn: 正义到底说了什么？她说：“天主的话离你很近，就在你的口里，就在你的心中。”这就是指我们关于信仰的宣讲。

text_en: because if you confess with your lips that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
text_cn: 如果你口里承认耶稣为主，心里相信天主使他从死者中复活起来了，你便可获得救恩，

text_en: For one believes with the heart and so is justified, and one confesses with the mouth and so is saved.
text_cn: 因为心里相信，可使人成义；口里承认，可使人获得救恩。

text_en: The scripture says, “No one who believes in him will be put to shame. ”
text_cn: 经上又说：“凡相信他的人，不至于蒙羞。”

text_en: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; the same Lord is Lord of all and is generous to all who call on him.
text_cn: 其实，并没有犹太人与希腊人的区别，因为众人都有同一的主，他对一切呼号他的人都是富有慈惠的。

text_en: For, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved. ”
text_cn: 的确，“凡呼号上主名号的人，必然获救。”

text_en: But how are they to call on one in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in one of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without someone to proclaim him?
text_cn: 但是，人若不信他，又怎能呼号他呢？从未听到他，又怎能信他呢？没有宣讲者，又怎能听到呢？

text_en: And how are they to proclaim him unless they are sent? As it is written, “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news! ”
text_cn: 若没有奉派遣，人又怎能去宣讲呢？正如所记载的：“传布福音者的脚步是多么美丽啊！”

text_en: But not all have obeyed the good news; for Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our message? ”
text_cn: 然而并不是所有的人都服从了福音。依撒意亚曾说过：“上主，有谁相信了我们的报道呢？”

text_en: So faith comes from what is heard, and what is heard comes through the word of Christ.
text_cn: 所以信仰是出于报道，报道是出于基督的命令。

text_en: But I ask, have they not heard? Indeed they have; for “Their voice has gone out to all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world. ”
text_cn: 但我要问：难道他们没有听过吗？一定听过了。“他们的声音传遍普世，他们的言语达于地极。”

text_en: Again I ask, did Israel not understand? First Moses says, “I will make you jealous of those who are not a nation; with a foolish nation I will make you angry. ”
text_cn: 但是我再问：难道以色列人不明白吗？首先梅瑟说过：“我要以那不成子民的人，激起你们的妒火；以愚昧的民族，惹起你们的怒气。”

text_en: Then Isaiah is so bold as to say, “I have been found by those who did not seek me; I have shown myself to those who did not ask for me. ”
text_cn: 继而依撒意亚也放胆说：“未曾寻找我的人，找到了我；对未曾访问我的人，我显现了。”

text_en: But of Israel he says, “All day long I have held out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people. ”
text_cn: 但关于以色列人却说：“我整天向悖(bèi)逆违抗的民族，伸出我的手。”
